summary: Buyers tracking rules passed scoped schema/authorization and emulator tests. Optional fields preserve old records; trusted admin ACL remains unchanged. Scope is this change, not an exhaustive application security guarantee.

attackChecks.publicListAndMixedContentLeak: Denied anonymous, client and freelancer get/list on every collection.
attackChecks.unauthorizedWrites: Denied create/update/delete for non-admin roles on every collection.
attackChecks.authorityAndPrivilegeEscalation: Uses existing active profile plus trusted admin claim/UID; forged claim, missing claim and suspended admin denied.
attackChecks.updateBypass: Create and update call the same validators; invalid and oversized payloads rejected in both operations.
attackChecks.storageAndTypeSafety: Allowed-key schemas and bounds cover every string/boolean/timestamp field; extra fields and wrong types denied.
attackChecks.ownershipHijacking: No user-owned records or owner fields introduced; contact company ID is immutable on update.
attackChecks.requiredFieldsAndTimestampManipulation: Missing required contact fields and stale updatedAt values denied; UI uses server timestamps.
attackChecks.stateTransitions: All six outreach statuses are editable by admins; unknown statuses denied.
attackChecks.orphanRecordsAndQueryMismatch: Parent records required for writes; same-batch parent creation and realtime collection lists pass.
attackChecks.pathTraversalCountersAndNumericOverflow: No storage paths, counters or numeric inputs introduced; IDs are bounded and parent existence checked.
attackChecks.deletionAndArchives: Hard deletes denied even to admins; archive updates pass without deleting linked records.
attackChecks.trackingValidation: 37 rule tests include optional tracking enums, dates, integer bounds, LinkedIn host restrictions, text lengths and metadata on create/update.
attackChecks.importProvenance: Browser creation cannot forge importedAt; updates preserve importedAt and only set manualUpdatedAt to server request time. Manual field masks accept only bounded known field names.
